name: Stacy Garrity
subject: Shameful
body:
We all know that Josh Shapiro is a petty, little man. But Josh Shapiro’s latest stunt is shameful.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/RCrEfQXpNuM?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
We all know that Josh Shapiro is a petty, little man. But Josh Shapiro’s latest stunt is shameful.
Pennsylvania is the Keystone State of our nation. Our revolution was sparked in Philadelphia. The American experiment was preserved on the fields of Gettysburg. And the industrial revolution that changed the course of human history was born in our Commonwealth.
But because Josh Shapiro put his political ambition ahead of sharing a moment of unity, **Pennsylvania will not be a part of celebrating America 250 at the Great American State Fair.**
America’s 250th birthday is about celebrating all that America is and all that we are! The United States has freed more people from tyranny and created more economic opportunity than any nation in history. That’s why people from around the globe, regardless of race, gender, or creed choose to come to our shores to achieve the American Dream. America is the shining city on the hill!
Yet Josh Shapiro decided to take this moment of unity and create a moment of division, all in the name of scoring cheap political points.
I served our nation in uniform for 30 years, where I defended our freedoms, our values, and our people. I didn’t serve a Republican America or a Democrat America. I served the United States of America. And I am proud to celebrate our nation’s birthday with every Pennsylvanian, regardless of political affiliation.
I hope you will join me this week in celebrating all that America has given the World and all the progress we will spark over the next 250 years.
God Bless,

| | Hello Peter,
Something exciting is happening.
Over the past several weeks, our campaign has continued to build momentum across Ohio's 8th Congressional District, and I'm proud to announce that we've earned the support of organizations and leaders who share our vision for a stronger, more equitable future.
I'm honored to have received the endorsements of:
✅ **Hamilton County Democratic Party** ✅ **Butler County Democratic Party** ✅ **Ohio Working Families Party** ✅ **Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate** ✅ **Newtown Action Alliance** ✅ **DC Statehood PAC**
These endorsements represent people who believe that our district deserves leadership that will fight for working families, protect our democracy, defend reproductive freedom, reduce gun violence, strengthen our economy, and make government work for everyone—not just the wealthy and well-connected.Every endorsement tells voters that this campaign is growing stronger.
But endorsements alone don't win elections.
People do.Grassroots supporters do.Volunteers do.Small-dollar donors do.
That's why I'm asking for your help today.
We're approaching one of the biggest fundraising deadlines of this campaign, and every contribution will help us:
* Reach more voters throughout Ohio's 8th District
* Expand our field and volunteer operation
* Print campaign literature and yard signs
* Increase our digital outreach
* Build the organization necessary to compete and win

Whether you can give [**$10, $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=0bc2ee38c1&e=c6e7dff14c) , your contribution sends a powerful message that this campaign belongs to the people.
Together, we're building a coalition that stretches across communities, organizations, and everyday Ohioans who believe we can do better.
The momentum is real.Now let's finish strong.
**Please make your contribution today and help us turn this growing movement into victory.**
Thank you for believing in our campaign and for standing with us every step of the way.
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District

| | | | | | Peter,

Michael Baumgartner loves to brag. He'll tell anyone who'll listen about all the millions he's _"delivered"_ to Eastern Washington.

What he won't mention? His votes.

He voted for the trade war. Over and over.
He cheerleads for the shooting war.
**Together, those wars have driven up prices and cost the people of Washington state an estimated** _**$3.5 BILLION.**_

We deserve a representative who fights for us - not someone who sets us on fire and then brags about saving us with a bucket of water.

[**That’s why I’m running to unseat him, and why I need your help. Our last major public FEC deadline before the Primary Election is on June 30. We’re about $13k short of our goal. Can you chip in a few dollars right now to help close the gap?**](https://us.list-manage.com/cRMF135HNap?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)****

Peter,

I’ll be honest, this is not the type of poll we want to see as absentee
voting kicks off in Michigan.

[ A ]A post from @PollTracker2024 showing Susquehanna poll results for the
US Senate Michigan Democratic primary. Abdul is leading at 22%, Haley
Stevens is at 20%, Mallory McMorrow is at 9%, and Not Sure is at 49%.

You might be thinking, “What gives?? You’re leading!” and yes, that’s
true.

But our AIPAC-backed opponent has narrowed our lead to just two points,
AND nearly half of voters are still undecided.

With $30+ million in AIPAC-funded ads, our opponent has nearly decimated
our lead.

That worries me, because with 49% of Michiganders still unsure of who
they’re voting for, it’s all but certain that an AIPAC-funded ad will come
across their screen.

If we don’t have the resources to fund our ads and expand their reach, the
last message these folks see before casting their ballots could be
something paid for and approved by AIPAC.

I'm not telling you this to scare you,
Peter. I'm telling you because
you deserve to know the actual situation — and because the only thing that
counters $30+ million in AIPAC spending is people who care enough to step
in.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Everyone will be watching
body:
**Peter, we have an important semi-annual fundraising deadline on June 30th.**
I’ll explain why this deadline is so important, but first — **[will you split a $5 donation between Wes Moore and my campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260627-2.5Rtp8n&refcode=em-20260627-2&t=1&akid=1557%2E1086043%2E4pPYFS)**
Here’s why this deadline means a lot to my campaign, Peter:
It’s the **_first public deadline_** since I became the Democratic nominee in this race for Texas governor, and political insiders, the national media, and Greg Abbott’s team will all be looking at whether our grassroots campaign has the strength to win.
So my team and I are setting our boldest goal yet: **_$1 million raised online by June 30th._ Here’s how much we’ve raised so far:**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260627-2.5Rtp8n&refcode=em-20260627-2&t=2&akid=1557%2E1086043%2E4pPYFS)
**[Will you split $5 or anything you can between Wes Moore and my campaign to help us jump-start this push?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260627-2.5Rtp8n&refcode=em-20260627-2&t=3&akid=1557%2E1086043%2E4pPYFS)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260627-2.5Rtp8n&amount=5&refcode=em-20260627-2&t=22&akid=1557%2E1086043%2E4pPYFS)**
Abbott has $106 million in the bank and a network of billionaire donors on speed dial, so we need to have the resources to fight back by our deadline.
Thank you,
Gina

Peter,
We just WON our runoff election in Louisiana by a landslide!
This is Jamie Davis, the lifelong family farmer and now the Democrat Nominee running to flip Louisiana's OPEN US Senate.
We are on the cusp of making history: a Black person has never represented the entire state of Louisiana in the US Senate. But this is our moment. The Miracle on the Mississippi is alive and well.

We didn't do this with billionaires or untraceable PAC donors. We did this solely with the contributions of individuals across the country--over 54,600 donors currently--who believe in what we can do when we stand up for the people and fight for the needs of working people.
I never thought I would be standing here as the Democratic nominee for US Senate in my beloved Louisiana. I farm the same land my grandfather worked as a sharecropper and we just sent a resounding message that we are not going back.
When I am elected I will be the first Black US Senator to be elected in Louisiana.
James Carville was so inspired by our performance that he said Democrats now have a "fighting chance" to flip Louisiana's open US Senate seat blue. He's right--but now we have to fight for it together.
It is no exaggeration to say that we just became MAGA's top target in November. [We are going to need everybody joining with us to compete against MAGA billionaires and oligarchs who want to buy this state. Peter, I just got off the stage in Savannah where a massive crowd just joined me to rally and organize in opposition to the Trump administration and my opponent, Mike Collins.
_Mike is a notorious bigot, antisemite, and an election-denying extremist who would serve Donald Trump mindlessly if elected to the Senate._
Republicans are going to come down here to Georgia and spend hundreds of millions of dollars to try to help Mike take this Senate seat for the President.
It’s going to take ALL of us to fight back and protect this seat.
And from the energy I just felt on stage, it’s clear Georgians are ready to do our part.
**There has never been a moment when restoring checks and balances and constraining the power of an out-of-control President is more important ... _and it's all going to come down to Georgia again._**
This U.S. Senate race will be decided by just a couple of percentage points, but we've been here before. We've done this before.
The whole country is counting on us to deliver the Senate majority once again.
[**Peter, if you’re outraged by what’s happening to this country — and you’re ready to fight back — please don’t wait: Donate $5 to my reelection campaign in Georgia right now.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.Bh0QdH&refcode=em260627-2-subs&utm_campaign=em260627-2-subs&t=3&akid=2439%2E5691347%2E0Qx2-m)

Please, contribute today.
Jon Ossoff

Comedian Amy Hoggart--of Full Frontal and the "What's Left" Substack--joins Cliff Schecter for a fast, funny hour decoding the political chaos across the Atlantic. Keir Starmer just became the least popular prime minister in recorded British history, got shoved out in a bloodless "coup," and is likely to be replaced by Manchester mayor Andy Burnham.
Nigel Farage's Reform is cratering after a £5 million crypto donation scandal. It's a wild story--and Hoggart, who actually loses sleep researching these constituencies at 3 a.m., is the perfect guide through it.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203455354&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzNDU1MzU0LCJpYXQiOjE3ODI2MDA1MzYsImV4cCI6MTc4NTE5MjUzNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.3Zl4j-44wXu6edItJjKM2_3agizjrTnNex-zOKR63-I)
But under the jokes is a warning every American Democrat should hear. Starmer's government quietly delivered--free childcare, renter protections--and told absolutely no one, the same fatal flaw Cliff sees strangling the Democratic Party: do the good thing, refuse to tell the story, and let the Farages and Trumps take the credit.
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203455354&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzNDU1MzU0LCJpYXQiOjE3ODI2MDA1MzYsImV4cCI6MTc4NTE5MjUzNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.3Zl4j-44wXu6edItJjKM2_3agizjrTnNex-zOKR63-I&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
Along the way you get Jimmy Carter, the theory that the funniest candidate always wins, Trump's con-man genius for reading a room, and a heated debate about cold baths. Two smart, funny people making the bleak stuff bearable.
Watch the whole thing.

a kid like this would become the 48th Governor of Pennsylvania?

I sure didn’t.

Growing up, I knew I wanted to follow in my parents’ footsteps and give
back to Pennsylvania. My mom was an educator, and my dad was the local
pediatrician. But after I nearly failed out of organic chemistry, I knew
I’d have to chart my own path.

So I decided to give back through public service. I flipped a State House
district Republicans controlled for twenty consecutive years and passed
some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history.

I led a fiscal and ethical turnaround as Montgomery County Commissioner.
And as your Attorney General, I went 43-0 against Donald Trump and his
allies to make sure your ballot was counted.

Now, I’m running for reelection as Governor — because there’s still so
much work left to do.

Unfortunately, our fundraising has been a little slow this month.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3473%2E21716%2EmTy3nE)
Hi, it's Connor — Sarah McBride’s Campaign Manager.
**I’m reaching out because we’re just a few days away from our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, and I’ll be honest with you: I’m stressed.**
Our fundraising has been a little slow this month, and after checking the books, we’re falling behind on our goal.
[**But I know that supporters like you have _always_ had Sarah’s back. Can you please pitch in $5 toward our $275,000 end-of-quarter goal before Tuesday’s deadline?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1223?c0=mcb-em-20260627-1.N7e0Jh&refcode=em20260627-3473&t=2&akid=3473%2E21716%2EmTy3nE)

MAGA has been _obsessed_ with Sarah since day one, and now Republicans are watching every dollar we raise.

Ken Burns here, friend. I’ve said this before and it’s now more relevant than ever: The power rests in our hands to secure the future of the Senate.
**_[I have more to say, but if you want to use that power in your own hands, and have a few bucks to spare, please consider donating to Roy Cooper’s campaign before his end-of-quarter deadline on Tuesday at midnight. Winning his race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate, so I hope you’ll join me.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk801&t=8&akid=1922%2E124072%2E7lfvr0)_**
Across this country, people are feeling the strain in ways that don’t always make the history books – but shape lives all the same. The cost of groceries that are too high. A lifesaving prescription that forces a difficult choice. A paycheck that doesn’t just stretch as far as it once did.
These are the quiet pressures that define a moment. | Roy Cooper has spent much of his life as a public servant working to ease those burdens.
Not seeking attention, but doing the work. Expanding access to affordable health care. Investing in public schools. Defending the idea that government, at its best, is not distant – but present, steady and accountable to the people it serves.
It is the kind of leadership that rarely makes noise. But over time, it leaves a mark.
There are those who would take the state in a different direction – who see division as a strategy, who mistake power for purpose. They are organized. They are well-funded by dark-money groups.
**_[We can beat them back. This work matters, and we won’t stop fighting. So please, will you chip in before Tuesday at midnight to help elect Roy Cooper for the U.S. Senate?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk801&t=9&akid=1922%2E124072%2E7lfvr0)_**
| | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk801&amount=5&t=10&akid=1922%2E124072%2E7lfvr0)
---
History has been written in moments like this – when people choose not to sit back, but to take part.
If you can, _[**give today**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk801&t=11&akid=1922%2E124072%2E7lfvr0)_. Help ensure that the next chapter of North Carolina reflects the very best of what this state has always tried to be.
Thank you for doing your part,

Ken Burns

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

The window to act early is closing – and it's closing FAST.
#
Peter, there’s an undeniable truth when it comes to political campaigns:
**Early money wins elections.**
Ads are cheaper when you book them early. Organizers need to get hired with enough time to effectively communicate with voters. Candidates build momentum when donors show up early to help build a strong infrastructure.
But here's the thing: We're already in June. Primaries are wrapping up. The general election battlefield is taking shape RIGHT NOW.
**The window to be an "early" donor – to get the most out of every dollar – is closing faster than you might think.**
**Republican super PACs have been reserving ad time for months.** Some of the biggest GOP groups have already committed to spending tens of millions of dollars in important races in places like Maine, Georgia, and Ohio.
_They didn't wait. And we can't either._
